evidence_boundary.statement: This registry records observed deployed-state findings and intended remediation. SEC-01 records one authenticated production control change: public WordPress registration was disabled and users_can_register=false was verified after reload. It does not assert that subscriber review, quarantine, cleanup, or any other production remediation is complete. Live ranking, traffic, legal compliance, conversion, or vulnerability exploitability are not inferred.
evidence_boundary.authenticated_security_evidence: Operator-reported authenticated WordPress observations and post-change reload verification dated 2026-08-13. No raw user export, account classification dataset, backup artifact, or screenshot is stored in this registry; the sampled identities do not establish that every Subscriber account is malicious.
evidence_boundary.graphify_boundary: Graphify maps the captured deployed snapshot; it is not proof of site-owned source architecture or factual truth.

items.title: Public WordPress registration was enabled alongside a large unreviewed Subscriber population

patterns: WordPress users assigned the Subscriber role
excludes: No sampled identity is classified as malicious solely from its username, display name, or apparent theme

items.current_evidence: Authenticated production observation on 2026-08-13: WordPress Settings > General had 'Anyone can register' enabled. The Users inventory showed 294 total accounts: 1 Administrator and 293 Subscribers. Sampled Subscriber rows were dominated by scam-, crypto-, casino-, or spam-themed identities; sampling does not prove that all 293 Subscriber accounts are malicious. The authorized operator disabled public registration in production and verified after reload that users_can_register=false. Subscriber review, quarantine, and cleanup have not been completed or claimed.
items.intended_fix: Keep public registration disabled, preserve and export the full user inventory, define an approved allowlist and account-classification policy, create and verify a recoverable backup, then conduct an evidence-preserving account review. Quarantine only accounts supported by approved evidence and retain an auditable disposition for every reviewed account; do not bulk-delete or label all Subscribers malicious from the sample.

verification_assertions.assertion: WordPress public registration remains disabled and users_can_register remains false after an authenticated Settings > General reload.
verification_assertions.method: Use authorized administrator access to reload Settings > General, confirm 'Anyone can register' is cleared, and independently read users_can_register through an authorized database or WP-CLI check when available.
verification_assertions.evidence_required: Timestamped authenticated settings evidence and, when available, an authorized option-value check showing false.

verification_assertions.assertion: A signed-out request to https://www.aiamigos.org/wp-login.php?action=register does not expose a usable public-registration form and does not permit creation of a new account.
verification_assertions.method: Check the endpoint in a clean signed-out session, record the status/redirect/body, verify the absence of an enabled registration form, and perform any controlled negative submission only under an approved test-account procedure.
verification_assertions.evidence_required: Timestamped HTTP/browser evidence showing registration unavailable, plus controlled negative-test evidence if production policy permits submission testing.

verification_assertions.assertion: The registration-control change is not represented as Subscriber cleanup: the observed 293 Subscribers remain unclassified until an evidence-preserving review records an approved disposition for each account.
verification_assertions.method: Audit the remediation log and compare it with the exported user inventory and account-disposition register.
verification_assertions.evidence_required: Inventory export, reviewer-approved disposition register, and an explicit reconciliation of the 294-account observation to later deltas.
